title_avd: TP-Link TL-WR940N RTSP Conntrack 功能中未经身份验证的远程代码执行(CVE-2026-12935)
description_raw: The TL-WR940N v6 router contains a vulnerability in its RTSP connection tracking module that can lead to a stack-based buffer overflow. The issue occurs when a LAN client initiates a connection to a malicious RTSP server controlled by an attacker. A specially crafted RTSP message may trigger improper memory handling within the kernel module.

provenance.trigger_requests_note: AVD 原文不含完整 RTSP request 序列
